description: Check a list of Portuguese addresses in one call: a column from a CRM or spreadsheet, an order import, a customer base before shipping or mailing. Each item is checked like suggest_address (a door number in the text picks the exact postal code; a postal code is looked up as such). Results come back in input order, one per item: id exactly as sent (null when not sent), q, status, cp7 and suggestion. status 'ok' — the postal code was determined and is in cp7; 'ambiguous' — no single answer (several candidates with nothing to tell them apart, a street with several postal codes and no door number, or just a locality): cp7 is null and suggestion is the best candidate for a person to confirm; 'not_found' — nothing matched: suggestion is null. suggestion has the same shape as a suggest_address suggestion. Up to 100 items per call; a call with N items counts as N requests against the rate limit (about 50 per 10 seconds per IP), so send up to 50 at a time. For a single address use suggest_address.

items.description: Addresses to check; results come back in this order

id.description: Your identifier for the row (order number, record id); echoed back unchanged

q.description: Address as free text — street, door number, locality — or a postal code

name: verify_addresses
